resolution_notes: docs_url: Verifier A is correct — www.amtrak.com is the consumer site, not API docs; no official developer portal exists. Prefer maps.amtrak.com as the service root (or null if no docs). example: Both verifiers flag the getTrainStatus path as outdated/unreliable reverse-engineering; amtraker and community sources use different StatusMaps/MapDataService paths that change and face anti-bot. Provide a conservative corrected example only if a live path can be confirmed, else a historical/community-noted form. status remains operational if maps.amtrak.com responds (HTTP 301).
